svg.title: Wildbound — mobile landscape encounter
svg.desc: 844 × 390 compact landscape SafeCanvas. 50 × 52 navigation buttons, 104 × 52 quickslots and 126 × 44 Befriend button. Roblox-owned movement and jump zones are shown as schematic outlines for spacing review, not authored game controls. Editable vector design reference for the native Roblox implementation. This is not a Studio screenshot or a file created with Figma.
